Contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renewal and line is at 94% utilization with no buffer, so I cannot run a parallel pilot. A small, guarded initial switch—proportional to one or two production runs—captures the cost reduction (memory_c2) while protecting delivery risk. Full transition is deferred to the next review when capacity returns. The planned action is conditional on the verified records confirming that onboarding was genuinely quick and that invoicing has historically been accurate; if verification fails, I would fall back to negotiate_terms or add_second_source rather than the switch.
